item.title: Commercial; rubbish clearance, 19th October
item.description:
Number 31 Crathie Road appear to be running some sort of commercial rubbish / house clearance business from a residential premises. Rubbish is routinely stored in their front garden, including items such as fridges, old mattresses, and at times even old commodes, all presenting health hazards. These old mattresses are then ripped open and broken down, with piles of metal springs left in ihefront garden. On 15th October this practiced was witnessed, and the plastic filling was seen blowing out of the front garden. This is leaving micro plastic being washed away into the sewer and soil.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Crathie Road, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
